description: Bedforms-ATM is a MATLAB toolkit from collaborators at the Pontifical Catholic University of Peru and TU Braunschweig. It measures scale and three-dimensional structure in natural or synthetic bed-form fields. Four applications provide wavelet analysis, Hovmöller analysis, multiscale discrimination and a three-dimensionality measure. Users provide bed-elevation surfaces or profiles, then receive measures that describe bed-form hierarchy and dynamics. Geographic and spatial resolution follow the supplied fluvial survey or synthetic surface; no fixed river reach or observation period comes with the software. The public repository provides code, sample input files and a user guide. Its README grants GNU GPL version 3 or later, making the software free to obtain, although MATLAB is a separate dependency. The results could help parameterise or check river hydraulics and sediment simulations relevant to inland waterways or flood defences. That downstream use is inferred and requires a separate flow model. A limitation is that results depend on survey sampling and choices of scale. No related catalogue record was identified. The MATLAB code and sample files were not run.
